dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped high-intensity perimeters are visible across the dorsal region. The geometry consists of thin, light-blue/grey filaments surrounding darker low-intensity centers, with the most prominent 3-5 structures showing jagged, non-uniform edges and a sharp gradient transition at the outer boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid clusters. Pixel intensity is concentrated in linear and curvilinear filaments rather than solid blobs; however, small localized clusters of 4-8 high-intensity pixels are present at the intersection points of the macro-annuli networks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent closed annuli located in the upper-mid dorsal section form a scalene triangle with the longest side oriented longitudinally. Two additional 'C' shaped structures posterior to this group form a secondary linear alignment parallel to the lower dorsal edge.
